about: Ten brand-only Bijuva supplies follow a dated note confirming a previous deep vein thrombosis whose exact date is unknown.
Possible finding: the record holds no line about a past venous thromboembolism. Reandron 1000 (testosterone) is supplied four times from August 2025.
The last Estradot patch was removed on 12 April 2026 and the first deep vein thrombosis occurred on 6 May 2026, with no later systemic hormone supply.
